author: Dale McRae
title: Westwood Plateau's TorqueMaster crisis — why a 1990s luxury showcase is calling us on Sunday afternoons.
lede_excerpt: Westwood Plateau was the showcase Coquitlam wanted in 1995 — built on the bones of the old Westwood Motorsport racetrack, anchored by a Robert Trent Jones golf course, marketed with the city's first "Street of Dreams" walkthrough. About 2,300 detached homes went up between 1991 a…
hero_alt: A wound torsion-spring tube above a Coquitlam garage with the original yellow Wayne Dalton TorqueMaster warning label still attached.
